programme.desc: Described as 'a long journey backwards to go forwards', Selina Thompson's one-woman show Salt premiered in 2016. Suddenly, the sweeper goes haywire, rampaging through town and sucking up anything in its path, including Madame Au Lait's clock key and very nearly Hopparoo too.

programme.title: Tickety Toc

programme.title: Tickety Toc

programme.title: Tickety Toc

Where is Hopparoo? Only his sharp ears can free them for Chime Time.

programme.title: Tickety Toc

programme.title: Tickety Toc

programme.title: Tickety Toc

programme.title: Tickety Toc
